rationale: A granular-cell variant within the neurohypophyseal pituicyte-lineage tumor family, arising from the posterior pituitary/infundibulum (pituitary gland, C751) rather than the craniopharyngeal duct (C752), restricting it to a proper subset of its ceiling.
source_name: Surgical Neurology International 2020 (PMC7265469) — pituicyte/neurohypophysis lineage of sellar-region posterior-pituitary tumors

subset_sites: Overlapping lesion of rectum, anus and anal canal
rationale: Cloacogenic (basaloid/transitional) carcinoma is defined as an anorectal tumor arising from the transitional cloacogenic zone of the anal canal near the dentate line; it is a squamous cell carcinoma variant of the anus. This restricts it to the anal codes within its ceiling, a proper subset excluding the vulvar and eye sites.
source_name: PMC2780104 (Epidermoid Carcinoma of the Anal Canal - basaloid/cloacogenic carcinoma)

rationale: The spindle cell type A designation derives from the Callender cytologic classification, which is specific to uveal (choroidal and ciliary body) melanoma and is not applied to conjunctival, corneal, lacrimal, or orbital melanomas. This restricts the term to the uveal codes present in its ceiling.
source_name: Ento Key - Intraocular Tumors in Adults (Callender classification of uveal melanoma)

term: Spindle cell uveal melanoma, type A
rationale: This term explicitly names uveal melanoma with Callender spindle A cytology; uveal melanoma arises in the choroid, ciliary body, and iris, of which only choroid and ciliary body are among the ceiling codes. This is a proper subset excluding conjunctiva, cornea, lacrimal gland, orbit, and overlapping eye.
source_name: Ento Key - Intraocular Tumors in Adults (uveal melanoma cell type)

rationale: Spindle cell type B is a Callender cytologic category applied specifically to uveal (choroidal/ciliary body) melanoma and not to non-uveal ocular melanomas. This restricts the term to the uveal codes present in its ceiling, a proper subset.
source_name: Ento Key - Intraocular Tumors in Adults (Callender classification of uveal melanoma)

term: Spindle cell uveal melanoma, type B
rationale: This term explicitly designates uveal melanoma of Callender spindle B cytology; uveal melanoma is confined to the iris, ciliary body, and choroid, of which only choroid and ciliary body appear in the ceiling. This is a proper subset excluding conjunctiva, cornea, lacrimal gland, orbit, and overlapping eye.
source_name: Ento Key - Intraocular Tumors in Adults (uveal melanoma cell type)

rationale: Undifferentiated (embryonal) sarcoma of the liver is a defined hepatic mesenchymal malignancy arising in the liver (predominantly the right lobe). The explicit 'of the liver' designation restricts it to C220, a proper subset of the ceiling excluding retroperitoneum, peritoneum, scrotum, and eye sites.
source_name: World Journal of Clinical Cases PMC7642548 (Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver)

rationale: Undifferentiated sarcoma of the liver (UESL) is a defined primary hepatic malignancy of mesenchymal origin; the 'of liver' designation restricts it to C220, a proper subset of the ceiling excluding the retroperitoneal, peritoneal, scrotal, and ocular sites.
source_name: Int J Clin Exp Pathol PMC4313983 (Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of liver, 9 cases)

rationale: DEVIL is defined exclusively as an HPV-independent, p53-wild-type verruciform/acanthotic squamous precursor of the vulva; it is not a recognized penile entity, restricting it to the vulvar subset of the code's ceiling.
Differentiated (HPV-independent) PeIN is defined as a precursor lesion of the penis associated with male genital lichen sclerosus, restricting it to the penile subset of the code's ceiling.
Differentiated PeIN is by definition a penile intraepithelial neoplasia (HPV-independent precursor of penile SCC), restricting it to the penile subset of the code's ceiling.
dVIN is defined as the HPV-independent, TP53-mutant precursor of vulvar squamous cell carcinoma arising in vulvar lichen sclerosus, restricting it to the vulvar subset of the code's ceiling.
VAAD is defined as an uncommon HPV-independent squamous proliferation of the vulvar epithelium associated with vulvar verrucous carcinoma, restricting it to the vulvar subset of the code's ceiling.
By name and definition this is HPV-independent vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia (dVIN/DEVIL/VAAD spectrum), restricting it to the vulvar subset of the code's ceiling.

WHO 5th ed. and the literature define adenoid basal carcinoma as a rare HPV-related epithelial neoplasm of the uterine cervix arising from cervical reserve cells, restricting it to the cervical subset of the code's ceiling.
Adenoid basal epithelioma is a WHO synonym for adenoid basal carcinoma, defined as a rare neoplasm of the uterine cervix, restricting it to the cervical subset of the code's ceiling.
source_name: International Journal of Clinical and Experimental Pathology (PMC)

rationale: This synonym for the indolent adenoid basal neoplasm is described exclusively as a cervical tumor derived from cervical reserve cells, restricting it to the cervical subset of the code's ceiling.
The ciliated cell variant of endometrioid adenocarcinoma is reported only as arising in the endometrium in all published cases, restricting it to the endometrial subset of the code's ceiling.

SEIC is defined as replacement of endometrial surface/glandular epithelium by serous carcinoma cells, i.e. the non-invasive precursor arising in the uterine corpus, restricting it to the endometrial/uterine subset (excluding ovary C569 and fallopian tube C570).
SEIC is by definition the endometrial serous intraepithelial precursor of uterine serous carcinoma, restricting it to the endometrial/uterine subset (excluding ovary and fallopian tube).

STIC is defined as the earliest morphologically recognizable serous carcinoma arising in the epithelium of the distal (fimbrial) fallopian tube, restricting it to the fallopian-tube subset of the code's ceiling.

subset_sites: Overlapping lesion of retroperitoneum and peritoneum
rationale: Invasive implants of ovarian serous borderline tumors are, by definition, epithelial proliferations located on/within the peritoneal surface; WHO 2014 reclassified them as peritoneal involvement (low-grade serous carcinoma), so the entity is restricted to the peritoneum within its ceiling.
source_name: PubMed PMC5298321 (Virchows Archiv, Ovarian borderline tumors in the 2014 WHO classification)

term: Primary serous papillary carcinoma of peritoneum
subset_sites: Overlapping lesion of retroperitoneum and peritoneum
rationale: By definition this is a primary peritoneal tumor arising from the peritoneal lining, diagnosed only when the ovaries are uninvolved, so it is restricted to the peritoneum within its ceiling.

HPV-independent gastric-type adenocarcinoma is a defined tumor of the uterine cervix (with documented vaginal counterparts), not an established primary of ovary, fallopian tube or endometrium, so it is restricted to the cervix/vagina subset of the ceiling.
source_name: PubMed PMC11075765 (Gastric-type adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix)

rationale: The descriptor 'endocervical type' defines this mucinous adenocarcinoma as a cervical (endocervical) entity, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling.
source_name: PubMed PMC11075765 (Gastric-type adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix)

rationale: Gastric-type mucinous carcinoma is a defined tumor of the uterine cervix (with reported vaginal cases), not an established ovarian, tubal or endometrial primary, restricting it to the cervix/vagina subset of the ceiling.
source_name: PubMed PMC11075765 (Gastric-type adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix)

rationale: HPV-associated adenocarcinoma in situ is a preinvasive glandular lesion of the uterine (endo)cervix, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling rather than other female-genital sites.
Cervical glandular intraepithelial neoplasia (CGIN) is by definition a glandular preinvasive lesion of the cervix, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling.
source_name: North Tees & Hartlepool NHS (Glandular abnormalities of the cervix)

rationale: HPV-independent (gastric-type) adenocarcinoma in situ is a recognized preinvasive glandular lesion of the uterine cervix, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling.
source_name: MyPathologyReport (Adenocarcinoma in situ of the cervix)

rationale: Atypical lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia is a precursor lesion of gastric-type adenocarcinoma arising in the uterine cervix (endocervical glands), restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling.
source_name: PubMed PMC10728631 (Atypical lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia)

term: Gastric-type adenocarcinoma in situ of cervix
rationale: The term explicitly names a gastric-type adenocarcinoma in situ 'of cervix', a preinvasive cervical glandular lesion, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling.

HPV-independent adenocarcinoma (NOS) is defined in WHO as an HPV-independent cervical adenocarcinoma category, restricting it to the cervix codes within the ceiling rather than other female-genital sites.
source_name: MyPathologyReport (Adenocarcinoma in situ of the cervix)

rationale: Diffuse pleural mesothelioma originates specifically from the mesothelial cells of the parietal or visceral pleura, restricting it to the pleura (C384) within its ceiling.
Localized pleural mesothelioma arises specifically along the pleural surface, restricting it to the pleura (C384) within its ceiling.
'Infantile embryonal carcinoma' is a historical synonym specifically for testicular yolk sac tumour of young children (under age 3), restricting it to the testis within the broad code ceiling.
'Orchioblastoma' (orchi- = testis) is an established synonym exclusively for testicular yolk sac tumour, restricting it to the testis within the broad ceiling.

subset_sites: Other specified parts of female genital organs
rationale: Gestational choriocarcinoma arises from placental/trophoblastic tissue of the female genital tract (uterus predominantly, also ovary/tube/vagina from ovarian pregnancy or metastasis); it does not arise in testis, mediastinum or CNS, restricting it to the female genital/placental subset.

term: Placental site trophoblastic tumor of testis
rationale: The term explicitly designates the testicular form of PSTT; primary testicular PSTT is confined to the testis within the ceiling.

subset_sites: Overlapping lesion of female genital organs
rationale: PSTT is a gestational trophoblastic neoplasm arising from the placental implantation site, nearly always in the uterine corpus/fundus (rarely other female genital sites); it does not arise in the testis, restricting it to the female genital/uterine subset.

Cystic trophoblastic tumour is described almost exclusively in testicular germ cell tumours (post-chemotherapy/retroperitoneal) and rarely in primary CNS germ cell tumours; it is a germ-cell-derived lesion not occurring at gynaecologic sites, restricting it to testis and CNS within the ceiling.
Adenocarcinoma of the rete ovarii arises from the rete ovarii in the ovarian hilus, i.e. the ovary only, a strict subset of the broad code ceiling.

subset_sites: Other specified parts of female genital organs
rationale: Mesonephric adenocarcinoma (HPV-independent) arises from Wolffian/mesonephric remnants of the female genital tract (cervix predominant, also vagina, uterine corpus, ovary, broad ligament, tube); it does not occur in the urinary tract sites of the ceiling.

subset_sites: Other specified parts of female genital organs
rationale: Mesonephric adenocarcinoma arises from mesonephric (Wolffian) remnants confined to the female genital tract (cervix, vagina, uterine corpus, ovary, broad ligament, tube); not the urinary sites in the ceiling.

subset_sites: Other specified parts of female genital organs
rationale: Wolffian (mesonephric) duct carcinoma arises from Wolffian duct remnants of the female genital tract (cervix, vagina, uterine corpus, ovary, broad ligament, tube); not the urinary tract sites in the ceiling.

Askin tumour is by definition the Ewing/PNET of the thoracopulmonary region, arising from the soft tissues of the chest wall; it is restricted to the thorax (connective/soft tissue of thorax) within the broad ceiling.
The named entity 'renal Ewing sarcoma' is defined as primary Ewing sarcoma arising in the kidney, restricting it to C649, a strict proper subset of the code's ceiling.
Hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular neoplasms are defined by WHO as primary tumors of the liver (hepatic parenchyma/intrahepatic biliary tree); they do not arise across the broad NOS ceiling of sites.
source_name: J Liver Cancer 2022 / WHO Classification of Digestive System Tumours 5th ed

rationale: Hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular neoplasms are defined by WHO as primary tumors of the liver (hepatic parenchyma/intrahepatic biliary tree); they do not arise across the broad NOS ceiling of sites.

rationale: Urothelial carcinoma arises from urothelium lining the urinary tract (renal pelvis, ureter, bladder, urethra); the named entity is restricted to urinary-tract sites, a proper subset of the ceiling.

rationale: Per WHO, sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma is defined as arising in the nasal cavity and/or paranasal sinuses; the entity is restricted to the sinonasal tract, a proper subset of the ceiling.
